44001.story: As of Oct 12, the record for Bristol County runs 75 years from 1951 to 2025. On the middle value of the county's 3 grids, May to June came in under 90% of normal in 37 of those years, the most of any pair. In 2025, November to December came in at 64% of normal on the middle, and in 2026 so far April to May sits at 58%. All 3 grids had their driest year in 1965, with grid 26036 at 54% of normal.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ

In 2026 so far, April to May sat at 58% of normal and June to July at 145% on the middle of the grids. All 3 grids had their driest year in 1965, with grid 26036 at 54% of normal that year.
